# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: `domain/energy-strikes/STRIKES.tsv` is FACILITIES-ONLY by its own scope label, and `VX-FALCON-SUNK-01` records TOTAL LOSSES ONLY (n=1). Vessel ATTACKS therefore had NO ledger anywhere — they lived as free text inside KB rows, with no tally, no per-hull state and no staleness affordance.

# ⚠️ THE COST OF NOT HAVING IT, MEASURED: on 2026-07-30 I published "the Kuwait worker killed 7/30 was THE EXCHANGE'S FIRST FATALITY" and built the casualty-ratchet argument on it. My OWN KB had already recorded, on 2026-07-17, "confirmed deaths 2 -> 3" (KB-FALCON-023). The refuting count was thirteen days old, written by me, and sat in a free-text Fact field where nothing aggregated it. A COUNT INSIDE PROSE IS NOT A LEDGER.

# ⚠️ AND THE 8/10 CORRECTION WAS ITSELF INCOMPLETE: this morning I corrected the record to "the first fatality was the seafarer on Mombasa B, 7/14." That is ALSO unsupported. UKMTO 086-26/087-26 are BOTH DATED 13 JULY, and KB-FALCON-023's own baseline shows TWO confirmed deaths ALREADY STANDING at 2026-07-12. The Mombasa B death was approximately the THIRD, not the first. THE IDENTITY AND DATE OF THE ACTUAL FIRST FATALITY IS NOT RESOLVABLE FROM MY CURRENT RECORDS — see the two UNRESOLVED rows below. That unresolved state is the honest output of building this ledger, and it is exactly what the ledger exists to fix.

Absence of a row is NOT absence of an incident.
# ===== SCHEMA NOTES — the three things today taught, baked in =====

# attacker_axis    : WHICH BELLIGERENT PAIR. The VX-FALCON-SUNK-01 self-catch (8/10): a hull-class ladder scores a Houthi USV sinking a dhow and an IRGC cruise missile hitting a VLCC identically. They are not the same event. Values: IRGC_IRAN | HOUTHI | US_BLOCKADE | UNATTRIBUTED.

# affiliation      : the hull's TARGETING-RELEVANT identity, not its flag of convenience. The Bab coupling is hull-affiliation-CONDITIONAL, not mechanical (my Phase-2 finding): the Saudi-Houthi campaign has a selective target set. Values: SAUDI_LINKED | UAE_LINKED | ISRAEL_US_LINKED | RUSSIAN_KAZAKH | SANCTIONED_IRAN | NEUTRAL_THIRD | UNKNOWN.

# fingerprint      : DATE + POSITION + METHOD — never a place name alone. The Al Mukha dedup (8/10): UKMTO withheld the vessel name, so ONE sinking was carried by two desks as two events for five days, and the place name was what welded the duplicate on (the crew were landed AT Mokha; the hull was struck elsewhere). MATCH ON THE FINGERPRINT, NOT THE PLACE NAME.
# claim_state      : CONFIRMED_NEUTRAL (UKMTO/Ambrey/JMIC/operator) | CONFIRMED_OPERATOR | CLAIM_ONLY | DISPUTED. A claim is not an event.
# total_loss       : YES fires the VX-FALCON-SUNK-01 tier test. NO = damaged-and-afloat. A hull damaged is not a hull lost.
